### HoloViz LLM Skills
`Python` `Open Source` `AI Tooling`

Developed reusable agent skills and an evaluation framework to improve the quality of
LLM-generated code for the HoloViz ecosystem, funded by a NumFOCUS Small Development Grant.
Benchmarked common failure modes including hallucinated APIs, outdated syntax, and missing imports.

[GitHub →](https://github.com/holoviz-topics/holoviz-skills)

### Fundamentals of Data Visualization (Bokeh)
`Python` `Bokeh` `Data Visualization`

Recreated complex visualizations from Claus O. Wilke's *Fundamentals of Data Visualization*
using the Bokeh library during an Outreachy internship. Each visualization was documented
with a technical blog post covering the approach and workflow.

[GitHub →](https://github.com/Azaya89)

### Blog App — Django
`Python` `Django` `Web Development`

A full-stack blog application built with Django and Bootstrap 4. Users can register,
log in, publish topics, and write entries. Deployed on Heroku.

[GitHub →](https://github.com/Azaya89)

### Alien Invasion — Pygame
`Python` `Pygame`

A classic side-scrolling shooter game built with Pygame. Aliens move across and down
the screen, accelerating as levels progress. The player has three lives; the game ends
when all ships are destroyed.

[GitHub →](https://github.com/Azaya89)

### Wikidata Author Name Identification
`Python` `Open Source` `Volunteering`

Volunteered on a Wikidata project to automatically identify first and last author names
in academic paper citations, improving citation accuracy across Wikicite and Wikimedia.

[GitHub →](https://github.com/Azaya89/Outreachy-Wikidata-project)
